issues: No hero number: promote the workspace total (€3.84M of €5.30M, 72%) from the sidebar footer to a large proportional-figure hero under the H1, with one primary pill action beneath it; delete the sidebar 'Allocated Budget' widget.
Two competing indigo primaries (top-bar 'Upload File' and page 'Open All 37'): keep one primary; demote 'Open All' to secondary or move it into a 'More' menu.
Money is set in monospace (€1.79M, €2.50M, €0k): switch all amounts to the UI sans with tabular-nums; drop mono everywhere except OZ codes.
Percent labels printed inside 6px progress bars (white '72%' on green/orange) are unreadable and fail contrast: remove in-bar text, show '72%' as a muted label beside the bar.

Cards are boxes-in-boxes (border + two internal hairline dividers + centred icon tile): drop the inner dividers, use a soft fill card with left-aligned icon/title/subtitle and amount right-aligned, or a Wise-style row list.
Unbudgeted folders show '€0k · 0% · Set cap' with an empty bar: replace with a single muted 'No cap set' link and hide the empty bar and 0%.
Status colour is applied to body text ('2 lists inside' turns orange): keep the count neutral grey and carry status only on the bar/dot plus a word ('Caution').
Mobile: folder count reads '7 Folders' vs 6 on desktop, action row wraps into an orphaned divider, and cards are ~240px tall each; collapse cards to compact rows and fix the count.

Seven action buttons across two rows (top bar: New Subfolder, Upload, Import CSV; page: Upload Files, New subfolder, New List, Open All) with two primaries: keep one primary ('New List' or 'Upload'), merge duplicates, move the rest to a kebab.

The folder total €1,794,610.90 is the right hero but set at ~15px monospace inside a bordered strip: set it at 32–40px proportional tabular sans directly under the title, with 'of €2.5M · 72%' muted beside it.
Inconsistent casing on duplicate buttons ('New Subfolder' vs 'New subfolder'): pick sentence case for all buttons.

Three list cards carry identical all-caps titles 'RINGSCHLUSS BRUNNENWASSER, [PERSON_132]'; the filename is the only differentiator but is tiny mono grey: make the filename/format the bold line and the shared title the muted subtitle.

Document cards repeat the folder name as a blue link on every card and use pink dots for 'PDF'/'Source file': remove the redundant folder link, show type as a neutral text label, drop the coloured dots.
Mixed icon tile colours (blue for lists, pink for documents, orange 'New List' icon): unify to one neutral icon tile style, reserve colour for budget status.
Card grid for lists wastes ~220px per card on a centred icon: convert lists and documents to row lists with amount right-aligned.
In-bar percentage text ('72%', '60%') is unreadable white-on-green: move outside the bar.

The list total (€536,991.65 of €800k) is buried in a 12px table footer and again in a mint panel: lead the page with one large proportional total + cap bar under the list title; delete the footer total line.

Bottom budget panel is a box-in-box (mint border, inner status pill, '-/3' carousel dots, segmented threshold legend, two CTAs, pagination arrows): collapse to one inline status line ('Within budget · 67% of cap · €263k left') with a single secondary action.
Green 'Request Budget Expansion' competes with indigo 'Add Item' as a second primary in a different hue: make it a secondary/ghost or move to a menu.
Single-tab strip in its own bordered card plus a breadcrumb that repeats the same filename, followed by ~40px dead gap: replace with an H1 list title and drop the lone tab box.
Money and quantities are monospace and OZ/Einheitspreis use different weights: set Gesamt/Einheitspreis in proportional tabular sans, keep OZ mono but at muted weight.

Column order puts EINHEIT after GESAMT and the quantity stepper (−/1/+) occupies 110px per row: place unit next to Menge ('1 psch'), replace stepper with an inline editable cell, right-align Gesamt as last data column.

Per-row trash + kebab duplicate destructive actions and every row repeats the same tool icon and the truncated category chip 'Baustelleneinrichtung ...': move delete into the kebab, drop the repeated row icon, group rows under category headers instead of chips.

Mobile: table scrolls sideways, titles truncate to 12 characters and Menge/Gesamt are off-screen: switch to stacked rows (title, OZ, amount right) on narrow widths; footer metadata 'D86 · D86' duplicates the format.
Einheitspreis input shows raw '5700' in monospace while Gesamt shows '€5,700.00': format the price input with locale grouping and currency, same proportional tabular face as the total.
Gesamt sits in a grey bordered box styled like an input: render it as a read-only large figure (not a field) so it reads as the result, and make it the drawer's focal number.
Langtext preserves hard source line breaks ('nach', 'für' orphaned on their own lines): reflow paragraphs for display, keep original breaks only in raw/edit mode.
Uppercase tracked micro labels (KURZTEXT, MENGE, EINHEIT) at ~11px grey are low contrast: use sentence-case 13px labels at AA contrast.
Header repeats the Kurztext (title and first field are identical): show OZ + title as header, drop the duplicate or make the title field the editable header.
Category path line under the select is ~11px pale grey and fails contrast: darken or remove it (the select already shows the category).
Footer 'Changes are saved in this browser' + ghost 'Reset changes' is near-invisible and there is no saved state indicator: show an explicit 'Saved' state and give Reset a visible secondary style.
Large empty band between Langtext and footer: let Langtext grow or pin footer closer.
The portfolio sum 'Σ €3,836,638.94' is 13px grey mono next to the H1: make it the hero (large proportional figure) with cap and % beneath; drop the Σ glyph.
In-bar '66%' labels are white on green at ~9px: put the percentage as text beside the bar and add a word for status (On track / Caution) so status is not colour-only.
Two rows are visually identical ('RINGSCHLUSS BRUNNENWASSER, [PERSON_132]', 249, €897,305.45): lead each row with the distinguishing filename/format, demote the duplicated title.
Filenames under titles are monospace grey and all-caps source titles shout: use sans muted subtitles; keep content verbatim but reduce weight.
Sort carets on every header add noise: show only the active sort arrow, reveal others on hover.
Totals column uses monospace bold: use proportional tabular sans to match Wise-style money.
Row icons are identical grey document tiles adding no information: remove or replace with a status ring.
Table has no narrow-width plan (5 columns + bar): define a stacked row layout (title, folder, amount, bar) for mobile.
'New Folder', sort 'Cost (High to Low)' and 'Select' are shown on an empty archive where they do nothing: hide toolbar controls when the view is empty, and never offer 'New Folder' inside Archived.
'0 Folders' count pill is noise on an empty state: hide counts at zero.
Dashed-border box around the empty state reads as a drop zone it is not: remove the dashed container, centre the illustration on the page background.
Inline '(⋮)' glyph in the helper copy is tiny and ambiguous: replace with words ('from the folder's More menu').
Empty-state icon is pale grey and small (~24px): increase to 40–48px in a soft tinted circle consistent with other empty states.
Breadcrumb 'Home > Workspace > Archived' differs from Trash's 'Home > Trash': use one breadcrumb pattern for all top-level nav pages (or none, since the sidebar already shows location).
Dashed-border container suggests a drop target: remove it and let the empty state sit on the page background.
Breadcrumb 'Home > Trash' is redundant with the selected sidebar item and inconsistent with Archived: drop breadcrumbs on top-level pages.
Empty-state icon is pale and small: enlarge in a soft tinted circle, matching the folder empty state.
No retention cue: add a muted line such as 'Items are kept for 30 days' so the page states its rule.
Helper copy is ~12px light grey: raise to 14px at AA contrast.
Result subtitles are monospace filenames ('LV_04_Porenbetonfassade.pdf') that visually outweigh the sans titles: use muted sans subtitles and show the parent folder instead of the filename.
Grammar '1 lists' in the folder result: pluralise correctly.
Query match ('Beton') is not highlighted in results: bold or tint the matched substring.
Results cut mid-row at the bottom edge ('Vorsatzschale Beton Stützwand Ost' half visible): size the list to whole rows or add a fade.
Uppercase micro section headers (FOLDERS, LISTS, POSITIONS) and footer hints are pale ~11px: raise contrast to AA.
Identical grey document icons for every list add nothing: replace with folder colour or amount on the right (lists could show their total right-aligned).

Upload/subfolder actions appear three or four times (top bar: New Subfolder, Upload, Import CSV; toolbar: + Upload Files, + Create Subfolder; centre: Import Item Lists & CSVs; quick actions: Create Blank List, Add Nested Subfolder) with three indigo primaries: keep only the centred empty-state CTA plus one secondary 'Create blank list'; remove the toolbar and top-bar duplicates.
Buttons combine an icon and a literal '+' ('+ Upload Files', '+ Create Subfolder'): drop the '+' text.
Layout differs from every other folder page (breadcrumb in a bordered pill, no H1, no subtitle, page in a bordered white card): use the same header pattern as S2 with the folder name as H1.
Breadcrumb order 'All Projects > Workspace > Legal & Compliance' contradicts other pages ('Home > Workspace > …'): unify.
Box-in-box-in-box: page card border containing a dashed dropzone containing a button: remove the outer card, keep one soft dropzone.
'Empty' monospace badge beside the breadcrumb restates the empty state: remove.
'Rename' and red 'Delete' sit top-right as equal-weight buttons: move both into a folder 'More' menu.
Supported-formats line is ~11px pale grey: raise to AA contrast.

global_issues: Replace monospace money/quantities everywhere with the UI sans plus font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; keep mono only for OZ codes, and use one currency format (no mixing €1.79M, €537.0k, €0k and €1,794,610.90 on one screen).

Establish one hero number per screen (workspace, folder, list, budgets totals) at 32–40px proportional figures with cap and % beneath; delete the sidebar 'Allocated Budget' widget and the duplicate footer/panel totals.
One primary button per screen: the top bar's indigo 'Upload File'/'Import CSV' competes with page primaries everywhere; demote top-bar actions to an icon/secondary and remove duplicate page actions.

Progress bars: remove the white percentage text printed inside 6px bars; show % beside the bar and add a status word so status is not colour-only; keep one palette (green/amber/red) and stop colouring body text.
Flatten surfaces: drop boxes-in-boxes (card borders + inner dividers, bordered strips, dashed containers on non-drop empty states); use soft fills, larger radius, fewer hairlines.
Prefer Wise-style row lists over centred-icon card grids for folders, lists and documents: left icon, bold title, muted subtitle, amount right-aligned.
Unify page header pattern (breadcrumb style, H1, count pill, action row) and casing (sentence case for all buttons, no uppercase micro labels below AA contrast) across all screens.
Mobile: the ledger table must reflow to stacked rows (no sideways scroll, no 12-character truncation), and the top bar's icon-only primary needs a label or tooltip.
